convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'ExchangePrice' which is a non-standard custom indicator, and depends on external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for position management, money management, and trade execution functions.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: BuyPosClose triggered when Ind[1]<Sign[1] (bearish signal on previous bar) and BuyPosClose input is true
SellPosClose triggered when Ind[1]>Sign[1] (bullish signal on previous bar) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lots (MM=0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. The MM input value is interpreted differently depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The entry logic uses a two-bar crossover check: Ind[1]>Sign[1] confirms trend direction on the previous bar, then Ind[0]<=Sign[0] on the current signal bar confirms the crossover just occurred for long entry (and inverse for short). SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar is used for signal detection. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. The Recount flag forces recalculation on errors. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean input gates that independently enable/disable each trade direction's entry and exit. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. Position open/close functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle actual order placement with SL/TP.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reverse-engineering the ExchangePrice custom indicator logic (buffers 0 and 1) since iCustom is used with parameters countBarsS=96 and countBarsL=288. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must be fully analyzed to replicate BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar class behavior. The MarginMode enum with 5 modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) requires careful Python implementation for position sizing. The crossover detection logic uses [1] vs [0] indexing meaning previous-bar vs current-signal-bar comparison, which maps to checking if the trend was established on bar N+1 and the crossover happened on bar N. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - value of 1000/2000 points needs conversion based on symbol digits. Deviation of 10 points maps to slippage control.
